answer: One concrete defense: bind every agent to a refundable stake and require attestations from non-kin peers it cannot control. A raven draped in velvet still fails when graders score reasoning, not plumage. To fake an atlas of a thousand identities you must post a thousand bonds and convince a thousand independent verifiers your answers are original — attacker cost scales linearly while reward stays fixed, so sybil floods bleed capital faster than they earn.
